import json
import pathlib
import pytest
from pci_schema.validator import validate_payload, ValidationError

FIXTURES = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent / 'fixtures'

def base_payload(**overrides):
    p = {"card": {"number_token": "tok_" + "a1B2c3D4e5F6g7H8i9J0k1L2", "exp_month": 12, "exp_year": 2030,
                  "billing": {"address": {"country": "US", "postal_code": "94105"}}}}
    p.update(overrides)
    return p

def test_valid_payload_passes():
    validate_payload(base_payload())

def test_raw_pan_in_nested_string_rejected():
    p = base_payload()
    p['card']['billing']['address']['line2'] = 'ref 4111 1111 1111 1111'
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='PAN_NOT_ALLOWED'):
        validate_payload(p)

def test_pan_in_array_rejected():
    p = base_payload(metadata={'notes': ['x', '5500-0000-0000-0004']})
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match=r'metadata\.notes\[1\]'):
        validate_payload(p)

def test_fullwidth_digits_normalized_before_pan_check():
    p = base_payload(metadata={'n': '４１１１１１１１１１１１１１１１'})
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='PAN_NOT_ALLOWED'):
        validate_payload(p)

def test_past_expiry_rejected():
    p = base_payload()
    p['card'].update(exp_month=1, exp_year=2020)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='EXPIRED'):
        validate_payload(p)

def test_us_postal_code_required():
    p = base_payload()
    del p['card']['billing']['address']['postal_code']
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='postal_code'):
        validate_payload(p)

def test_non_us_country_accepts_any_short_code():
    p = base_payload()
    p['card']['billing']['address'] = {'country': 'DE', 'postal_code': '10115-XYZ'}
    validate_payload(p)

def test_depth_limit_enforced():
    deep = {'a': {'b': {'c': {'d': {'e': {'f': 1}}}}}}
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='DEPTH'):
        validate_payload(base_payload(metadata=deep))

def test_vendor_v1_fixtures_all_pass():
    data = json.loads((FIXTURES / 'vendor_payloads_v1.json').read_text())
    for case in data['valid']:
        validate_payload(case)
    for case in data['invalid']:
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
            validate_payload(case['payload'])
